about_the_game:
Majoris Nightmare is a dark narrative-driven puzzle-adventure built around investigation, tension, and consequence. After tragedy shatters his life, Majoris enters a seemingly ordinary house in search of answers, believing its owner may be connected to his daughter's disappearance. Solve puzzles, face rare moments of danger, and make difficult choices because a single wrong move could mean losing her forever.

As Majoris searches for his daughter, the world around him shifts in unexpected and dangerous ways. He must stay quick and alert to survive these moments of sudden threat and keep his hope alive.

Not all obstacles come from the world itself. Some are left behind by those who don’t want Majoris to uncover the truth. Solving puzzles, finding clues, and unlocking hidden paths are the only way forward because each challenge is designed to slow him down or throw him off course.

With years of experience as a journalist, Majoris knows how to follow a lead. Scattered notes and hidden writings may hold pieces of the truth and each one could bring him closer to his missing daughter.

Majoris has already lost someone he loved. He refuses to let it happen again. No matter the cost, he will uncover the truth and bring his daughter back. She is his last reason to keep going and he won’t stop until she’s safe.

FEATURES:

  • Note Collection: Explore and gather scattered notes that help Majoris piece together the story and uncover where his daughter might be.

  • Single Enemy Encounter: React fast and shoot the only creature standing in your way before it reaches you. Timing is everything.

  • Puzzle Solving: Progress through the game by solving different types of puzzles using logic, observation, and exploration.

  • Critical Decision-Making: Make a single key choice that determines whether Majoris will succeed or lose what matters most.

  • High-Tension Moment: Experience a one-time quick time event that demands fast reflexes to escape danger.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of violence and blood.

Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600, 3.30GHz or newer
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
